title: Display current time
text: The clock shall have a display that shows the current time in hours, minutes, and seconds.

title: Display alarm settings on request
text: On request, the clock shall display the current alarm settings in hours and minutes.

title: Alarm buzzer
text: The clock shall have a buzzer that sounds an alarm at the specified time.

title: User time and alarm setting button
text: The clock shall have a button that allows the user to set the current time and alarm time.

title: Continuous power operation
text: The clock shall have a power source that allows it to operate continuously without interruption for up to 60 days.

title: Display visibility distance
text: The clock display shall be visible from a distance of at least 3 meters in normal lighting conditions.

title: Display visibility angle
text: The clock display shall be visible from an angle of at least 45 degrees from all directions in normal lighting conditions.

title: Alarm sound level
text: The clock buzzer shall have a sound level of at least 70 decibels at a distance of 1 meter.

title: Drop resistance
text: The clock shall survive a drop from a height of 1 meter onto a hard surface without damage to the display or buzzer.

title: Operating temperature range
text: The clock shall operate in a temperature range of -10°C to 50°C without damage.

title: Operating humidity range
text: The clock shall operate in a humidity range of 10% to 90% without damage.

title: Display stability angle
text: The clock shall stand stable on a flat surface with the display forming an angle of 30 degrees ± 2 degrees with the horizon.

title: Power-up default state
text: The clock shall initialize to a valid default time and alarm state after power-up.

title: Snooze feature
text: The clock shall allow the user to snooze the alarm for a specified duration.
